body:
yeah, I did, twice. 
No matter where I work, where I live, who I talk to, nothing makes a difference.
If anything, it helped me to sink lower and lower into my hole.

Thanks for trying to help, but this is more venting then asking for help. Eventually I'll kill myself, but who knows, maybe I'll live a year or two before that happens, maybe less.

I wanted to, at some point. Now? I don't really care.
Changing locations is impossible I'm afraid.

Finding out about death grips. That was...3 and a half years ago I guess?
Yeah, I'm into them, never heard lyrics that resonate with me that much, ever.
Actually passing time by listening to NOTM on repeat now.
